name: Essam Fadel
role: Research and development specialist in BIM & innovation

experience.summary: Research and teaching at the Chair of Intelligent Technical Design, with a focus on digital construction processes, BIM and data management.
Developing and integrating digital methods, innovation projects and technology solutions across the planning, construction and operations value chain.
Supported research through simulation, virtual and mixed reality, teaching preparation and documentation.
Coordinated construction work packages for a structural-concrete project, including planning, scheduling and cost monitoring.

projects.name: Handwerk der Zukunft
projects.summary: Data-driven planning and human-robot interaction in existing buildings, linking craft expertise, BIM workflows and robotics.

projects.name: Digital-TWIN
projects.summary: Mixed-reality tools for HoloLens, a 4D VR simulation with Oculus and DESITE MD, and immersive IFC-web-viewer extensions for urban planning data.

projects.name: BIM-SPEED
projects.summary: Project-requirement and financial-management work, including BIM marketplace, BIM passport and BIM execution-platform concepts.

projects.name: BIMSWARM
projects.summary: Further development across project management, analytics dashboards, Jenkins-based DevOps workflows and operational improvements.

projects.name: BIM-KIT
projects.summary: IFC-model and JSON-IFC generation services, platform integrations, and a Camunda-based backend microservice for workflow automation.

projects.name: EConBIM
projects.summary: Requirement catalogues, interface concepts and secure remote-access services delivered as containerized applications for construction workflows.

projects.name: Construct-X
projects.summary: Use-case and requirement work for Construct-X, including an Eclipse Dataspace Connector app with SharePoint integration.

publications.title: A Data-Space-Oriented Architecture for Craft-Oriented Construction
